text: The project targets direct benefits for 385,956 people (55% women) and indirect benefits for 1,986,980 people, totaling approximately 2.3 million beneficiaries. It aims to lower water levels in four lakes, upgrade early warning systems, expand hazard monitoring, and implement reforestation over 150 hectares. The project is valued at US$36.158 million from the GCF grant, with an additional US$13.786 million in co-financing.

metadata.solution_name: FP272: Protecting livelihoods and assets at risk from Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) and climate change-induced flooding in glacial river basins of Nepal
